properties.description:
Editing a colored document currently makes the text flash white while the language server computes the next coloring result.

Keep the existing color formatting visible during this wait, and replace it only when the new applicable coloring result arrives. Apply the replacement together so there is no intermediate uncolored frame. Account for edited text positions and reject stale or out-of-order responses.

Verify TypeScript and JSON with rapid typing, deletion and undo, including deliberately delayed language-server responses. Unsupported files must remain normally editable.
properties.title: Keep text colors visible until updated language-server colors arrive
